name: Government of Montserrat Data Centre / DITES data centre upgrade
developer: Government of Montserrat Department of Information Technology & e-Government Services (DITES)
notes: Official DITES page lists 2020/21 strategy to upgrade the data centre with new servers, storage equipment, faster fibre connections to ISPs, and fibre links from the data center to GoM offices. Search result for the 2015 official tender references a backup diesel generator for the Government of Montserrat Data Centre and DITES office. DITES contact details place it at Government Headquarters, Brades, MSR1110; Brades/Government Headquarters is in Saint Peter Parish. No MW capacity found.
